name: Rows loaded equal rows published (Medicaid product list)
NDC is an 11-digit code (labeler 5 + product 4 + package 2)
result: 88 rows are not; set aside in quarantine_sdud
rule: 0 rows in the facts that are not 11 digits
note: Placeholder rows ('** FROM CL') and codes that lost leading zeros. They never reach the facts; the dollars on them are blank (suppressed), so the market total is unaffected.

name: No negative amounts, units or prescription counts
note: Reversals and adjustments are netted by the source before publication.

name: Medicaid + non-Medicaid amount equals total amount (to 5 cents)
note: Source rounding. Total amount is used throughout; the Medicaid/non-Medicaid split is only shown separately.

name: Year and quarter are in range
One row per utilization type, state, NDC, year and quarter
One row per NDC in the product master
note: The product list is a quarterly snapshot; the latest snapshot per NDC is kept.

name: Sum of the state and territory rows vs the published national (XX) row
result: state and territory rows are 6.3-7.2% below national, every year
note: Cells with fewer than 11 prescriptions are blanked in the state rows but counted in the national row. National totals therefore come from XX; state shares are shares of reported (unsuppressed) spend.

name: Share of state-level rows with values suppressed
note: Suppressed rows carry no units or dollars. They are kept (not dropped) so row counts reconcile.

name: Spend whose NDC is in the Medicaid product list (gives manufacturer, brand/generic, dates)
note: Dollars on NDCs the list does not know are reported as 'unmatched', never guessed.

name: Spend matched to the FDA product directory (ingredient, class, approval type)
note: The directory lists current products, so discontinued NDCs seen in older Medicaid years are missing. Matching on the nine-digit labeler+product code recovers packs the directory does not list.

name: Spend with an active-ingredient key
note: Salts and hydrates are stripped and combinations sorted so one molecule has one key.

name: Spend assigned to a therapeutic area
result: 97.83% (FDA class 71.72%, borrowed from same ingredient 6.01%, curated list 20.11%); 2.17% unclassified
note: Area comes from the FDA pharmacologic class, then the same ingredient, then an editable name list (data/ref/). Unclassified spend is shown as its own bar in every chart, never spread across other areas.

name: Manufacturer spellings collapsed to parent companies
note: Case and punctuation variants merge by rule; completed acquisitions are mapped by an explicit, tested list.

name: Product names in the utilization file are cut at 10 characters
result: 100.0% of rows are exactly 10 characters long
note: Names such as 'LEVOTHYROX' are not used. Product identity comes from the NDC, joined to the product list.

name: Spend on NDCs missing from the product master is immaterial
note: These rows stay in the facts with an empty product; charts group them as 'Unmatched'.

name: Newest period in each source
note: 2026 is a partial year in the source and is left out of annual comparisons on purpose.

name: Enrollment: one value per state and month
result: 5,510 duplicate months resolved (updated value kept over preliminary); 51 states
